title: Desire
speaker: Zoketsu Norman Fischer
summary: Zoketsu Norman Fischer suggests that true fulfillment and joy come from embracing our deepest desires and longings, rather than trying to suppress or satisfy them. This can involve confronting the pain and suffering that often accompanies these feelings, but ultimately leads to spiritual growth and awakening. By letting go of expectations and complacency, we can tap into a sense of inner peace and awareness that is not dependent on external objects or experiences, but rather on the present moment itself.
